retained_exploration.v1: one array file per field/per-frame SAM mask; correct outputs but excessive mounted-filesystem IO
retained_exploration.v2: contiguous array blocks and grouped SAM masks; mounted-filesystem scratch
retained_exploration.v3: explicit local scratch and per-stage split; schedule snapshots match this package

limits: Two scheduling repetitions only, reversed variant order on repetition 2; cold process/startup costs included.
Seeded stage probes support numerical adapter equivalence; production scheduling PnP RNG is not fixed.
RSS sums processes and may count shared pages repeatedly; sampled peaks can miss transients; VRAM is device scope.
Retained prepared files count in scratch; release cost term retires active admission bytes, not physical disk when keep_prepared=true.
8-second/400-frame RGB case is longer than the short probes, not minutes/hours or TB-scale validation.
No physical multi-GPU, automated capacity tuning, shared SAM2 loader, global RAM/temp hard limit, or external-framework throughput comparison.
